newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: BHP recommits to 15 pct return on capital.
newsitem.headline: BHP recommits to 15 pct return on capital.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd (BHP) recommitted itself to a target of 15 percent return on capital and a pay-back of cost of capital within three years, a spokesman for BHP quoted BHP Steel chief executive officer Ron McNeilly as telling analysts at a briefing on Tuesday.
BHP group chief executive John Prescott also told the briefing that the company was fully committed to the measures related to its restructuring of the steel division announced earlier on Tuesday.
BHP announced it would phase out steelmaking at its Newcastle plant by the end of 1999.
The company also said it planned to close its Geelong rod mill and Sydney wire mill in 1999.
Based on a review of domestic and international steel operations, BHP said it would disband its international steel division and restructure BHP Steel around four divisions.
